keyPhrases.text: I am firmly in Van Hove's camp on this one
marks more than a return to form
restores the vitality to a musical
jolts theatergoers with as much innovative force
can seem ersatz and lumbering when treated like a museum piece

reasoning: Strong endorsement with enthusiastic praise for the innovative direction, choreography, and design. Minor concerns about processing the multilayered staging don't diminish overall positive recommendation. Compares favorably to Hamilton and praises restoration of vitality to the classic.
